title: Marine Mooring Line – Elastic & UV-Resistant
descriptionHtml:
Go easy on the boat when it gets rocky at the dock

A regular mooring line jerks hard on both the boat and the fittings every time a wave or swell pulls. It wears on deck fittings, cleats and nerves – especially on windy nights.

The elasticity absorbs the jerks

The elastic mooring line stretches softly when the boat moves and springs back. Instead of hard jerks you get an even, gentle load. The material is resistant to saltwater, UV radiation and abrasion.

Features

  • Elastic – dampens jerks from waves and swell
  • Resistant to saltwater, UV and abrasion
  • Protects the boat's fittings, cleats and deck
  • Easy to attach to the dock and boat
  • Gives a calmer, more secure mooring

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
